text: Under the City and County of San Francisco's Housing Code section 351(a), before the sale or exchange of a residential building (except the first sale or exchange, if it occurs within one year of the date of the Certificate of Final Completion of the building's construction), the owner or their authorized agent must obtain a Report of Residential Building Record from the San Francisco Department of Building Inspection. This is a San Francisco rule, not California law.
jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco

source.title: SF Housing Code - Section 351 - Report of Residential Building Record

quote:
(a) Report of Residential Building Record Required. Prior to the sale or exchange of any residential building, except the first sale
or exchange, if this occurs within one year of the date of the Certificate of Final Completion of the construction of the building, the
owner thereof, or their authorized agent, shall obtain from the Department of Building Inspection, a Report of Residential Building
Record.
verification_reason: The claim states the first-sale exception and who obtains the report; the meaning of residential building is in clm:2.

gates.text: Except the first sale or exchange, if it occurs within one year of the date of the Certificate of Final Completion of the construction of the building.
Applies to a 'residential building' as defined in section 351(b), which excludes hotels with 30 or more guest rooms and motels.

text: For the purposes of San Francisco Housing Code chapter 3.5 (sections 351 to 353), a residential building is a building or a portion of a building containing one or more dwelling units, not including hotels containing 30 or more guest rooms, or motels. This is a San Francisco rule, not California law.
jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco

source.title: SF Housing Code - Section 351 - Report of Residential Building Record

quote:
(b) Residential Building Defined. A residential building, as used in this chapter, is a building or a portion thereof containing one or
more dwelling units but not including hotels containing 30 or more guest rooms, or motels.

gates.text: Definition applies 'as used in this chapter' (Housing Code chapter 3.5).
Hotels containing 30 or more guest rooms, and motels, are not residential buildings for this chapter.

text: Under San Francisco Housing Code section 351(a), the Report of Residential Building Record must be delivered by the owner, or the owner's authorized agent, to the buyer or transferee of the residential building before the sale or exchange is consummated. This is a San Francisco rule, not California law.
jurisdiction: City and County of San Francisco

quote: Such Report of Residential Building Record shall be delivered by the owner, or the authorized agent of said owner, to the buyer or transferee of said residential building prior to the consummation of the sale or exchange thereof
